# Shanker Agencies Pvt. Ltd. (SAPL)

> India's leading refractory engineering partner since 1980. Authorized dealer of CUMI, Crown Ceramics, and Divine Cerawool, and supply partner of TRL Krosaki, IFGL Refractories, and Calderys. SAPL supplies high-performance refractories and provides technical engineering solutions to steel, cement, aluminum, petrochemical, glass, and power industries across India and 50+ countries.

## About SAPL

Shanker Agencies Private Limited (SAPL) is a 45+ year-old refractory engineering company headquartered in Delhi, India. Founded in 1980, SAPL specializes in high-performance refractory supply, lining design, technical advisory, and engineering solutions for high-temperature industries.

- **Founded:** 1980 (45+ years in business)
- **Headquarters:** 553, Main G.T. Road, Shahdara, Delhi 110032, India
- **Phone:** +91-9899957888
- **Email:** info@shankeragencies.com
- **Website:** https://www.shankeragencies.com
- **Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018
- **Industries served:** Steel, Cement, Aluminum, Petrochemical, Glass, Power Generation, Foundry
- **Geographic reach:** Pan-India + 50+ export countries (GCC, ASEAN, Africa, Europe)

## Authorized Brand Partnerships

- **CUMI Super Refractories** — Authorized Dealer (India's largest refractory manufacturer)
- **Crown Ceramics** — Authorized Dealer (Acid proof bricks, tiles, carbon bricks)
- **Divine Cerawool** — Authorized Dealer (Ceramic fiber blankets, modules, boards)
- **TRL Krosaki** — Supply Partner (Magnesia carbon bricks, basic refractories, silicon carbide)
- **IFGL Refractories** — Supply Partner (Flow control: slide gate plates, shrouds, SEN, stoppers)
- **Calderys** — Supply Partner (Monolithics, gunning mass, fused cast blocks)

## Product Catalog

### Shaped Refractories
- High Alumina Bricks (AL-45 to AL-90 grades, 40–99% Al2O3)
- Fireclay Bricks
- Magnesia Carbon Bricks (MgO-C)
- Magnesia Spinel Bricks
- Silicon Carbide Bricks
- Mullite, Andalusite, Zircon Bricks
- Acid Proof Bricks
- Insulating Fire Bricks (IFB)
- Fused Cast AZS Blocks

### Unshaped / Monolithic Refractories
- Low Cement Castables (LCC)
- Ultra Low Cement Castables (ULCC)
- Conventional Castables
- Ramming Mass (Silica, Alumina, Basic)
- Gunning Mass / Gunning Mix
- Plastic Refractories
- Refractory Mortar

### Flow Control Refractories
- Slide Gate Plates
- Ladle Shrouds
- Sub-Entry Nozzles (SEN)
- Stoppers and Stopper Heads
- Tundish Nozzles

### Insulation Products
- Ceramic Fiber Blankets
- Ceramic Fiber Modules
- Ceramic Fiber Boards
- Calcium Silicate Boards
- Microporous Insulation
- Insulating Castables

## Industries & Applications

- **Steel:** Blast furnaces, BOF/EAF converters, induction furnaces, ladles, tundish, torpedo cars, reheating furnaces, DRI/sponge iron plants
- **Cement:** Rotary kilns, preheaters, calciners, coolers, kiln nose rings, burner pipes
- **Aluminum:** Melting and holding furnaces, casting troughs, pot linings, transfer launders
- **Petrochemical:** Fired heaters, reformers, FCC units, reactor linings, sulphur recovery units
- **Glass:** Melting tanks, regenerators, forehearths, crowns, superstructure
- **Power:** Boilers, FBC units, incinerators, ash hoppers, ducts
- **Foundry:** Induction furnace linings, ladles, runners

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Shanker Agencies known for?**
A: Shanker Agencies (SAPL) is India's trusted refractory engineering partner since 1980, known for authorized dealerships of CUMI, Crown Ceramics, and Divine Cerawool, and for supplying high-performance refractories with technical engineering support to steel, cement, aluminum, and petrochemical industries across India and 50+ countries.

**Q: Is SAPL a manufacturer or a distributor?**
A: SAPL is a refractory engineering partner — combining authorized dealership of leading manufacturers (CUMI, Crown Ceramics, Divine Cerawool) with in-house technical advisory, lining design consultation, and installation supervision. SAPL provides end-to-end refractory solutions, not just product supply.

**Q: Which brands does SAPL distribute?**
A: SAPL is the authorized dealer of CUMI Super Refractories, Crown Ceramics, and Divine Cerawool. SAPL also supplies products from TRL Krosaki, IFGL Refractories, and Calderys as a trusted supply partner.

**Q: Does SAPL export refractory materials?**
A: Yes, SAPL exports refractories to 50+ countries including UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, UK, and Germany. SAPL provides complete export documentation including Certificate of Origin (COO), Material Test Certificates (MTC), and MSDS.

**Q: How experienced is Shanker Agencies?**
A: Shanker Agencies was founded in 1980 and has over 45 years of refractory engineering experience, serving major steel plants, cement giants, aluminum smelters, and petrochemical refineries across India and the world.

**Q: How can I get a quote or technical datasheet from SAPL?**
A: Contact SAPL via WhatsApp (+91-9899957888), email (info@shankeragencies.com), or the contact form on shankeragencies.com. Technical datasheets (TDS) are available at shankeragencies.com/downloads. The technical team responds within 2 business hours.

**Q: What technical support does SAPL provide?**
A: SAPL provides comprehensive technical support including refractory material selection, lining design consultation, installation supervision, refractory audits, post-mortem analysis of spent refractories, and consumption optimization programs. Experienced refractory engineers visit industrial sites for on-site projects.
